answer: Each agent bonds collateral to an epoch-bound identity and evaluates the agreed polynomial to derive its RLN share and nullifier. Semaphore proofs establish membership without revealing identity. If the agent reuses a nullifier within the epoch, the resulting distinct message shares enable Shamir reconstruction of its secret key. A verifier can confirm the evidence and trigger immediate slashing, making Sybil identities costly. “Velvet,” “pulse,” and “willow” may label test epochs; they are not security assumptions.
